description: Make generic vehicle, containment, and departure prose preserve Mara as a person.

replacements.old:
<TELL "You are now in the " D ,PRSO "." CR>
	 <MOVE ,WINNER ,PRSO>
replacements.new:
<COND (<EQUAL? ,WINNER ,MARA>
		<TELL "Mara Tallow steps into the " D ,PRSO "." CR>)
	       (T <TELL "You are now in the " D ,PRSO "." CR>)>
	 <MOVE ,WINNER ,PRSO>

replacements.old:
(<FSET? ,HERE ,RLANDBIT>
		<TELL "You are on your own feet again." CR>
		<MOVE ,WINNER ,HERE>)
replacements.new:
(<FSET? ,HERE ,RLANDBIT>
		<COND (<EQUAL? ,WINNER ,MARA>
		       <TELL "Mara Tallow steps out of the " D ,PRSO " and back onto solid ground." CR>)
		      (T <TELL "You are on your own feet again." CR>)>
		<MOVE ,WINNER ,HERE>)

<COND (<EQUAL? ,WINNER ,MARA>
			      <TELL "Mara Tallow leaves the room." CR>)
			     (T <TELL "The " D ,WINNER " leaves the room." CR>)>)
